text:
US/Eastern offset in 1783: UTC-5 (standard before DST existed).  
Europe/Paris offset: UTC+0:09:21 (historical, but often approximated as UTC+0 for simplicity in such problems; if not given, use UTC+1 for modern problems, but 1783 Paris used local mean time ≈ UTC+0).  
Using UTC+0 for Paris:  
9:00 (US/Eastern) = 14:00 UTC (since 9 + 5 = 14).  
UTC to Paris: 14:00 + 0 = 14:00.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 14:00
